name: Userlytics
description_en:
Userlytics is a remote user-research platform for testing websites, apps, prototypes and content with recruited or self-sourced participants. It combines moderated and unmoderated methods with recordings and analysis tools.

Its AI-assisted study design and synthesis sit alongside research methods; they do not remove the need to define a target audience, review source material and distinguish observed difficulty from a guessed cause.
description_zh:
Userlytics 是远程用户研究平台，可用招募或自有参与者测试网站、应用、原型和内容，结合有主持人与无主持人的研究方法、录制和分析工具。

AI 辅助研究设计和归纳与研究方法并存，仍需要明确目标人群、复查原始材料，并区分已观察的困难与推测原因。

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_zh: 研究方法与参与者来源
sections.en: The official site distinguishes moderated, unmoderated and AI-moderated studies, as well as qualitative and quantitative research. Participants can come from the Userlytics panel, specialized recruitment or your own audience. Those choices affect what can be learned: an opted-in panel can test a workflow, but it is not automatically your installed customer base.
sections.zh: 官网区分人工主持、无主持人和 AI 主持研究，也区分定性与定量研究。参与者可来自 Userlytics 样本库、专项招募或自有人群。这些选择影响结论边界：自愿加入的样本可以测试流程，但不自动等于现有客户群。

sections.title_zh: 示例：比较两条入门路径
sections.en: Define the same onboarding goal for two prototype variants and recruit people who match the intended role. Record the task, collect an explanation of obstacles, and compare the clips with the completion evidence. Do not attribute a difference to design if one group has different prior experience. Userlytics documents prototype testing, branching logic and video analysis; this proposed study was not run.
sections.zh: 为两个原型版本定义相同入门目标，招募符合目标角色的人。录制任务，收集对障碍的解释，再把视频片段与完成证据对照。若两组既有经验不同，不能直接把差异归因于设计。Userlytics 文档介绍原型测试、分支逻辑和视频分析，本文并未运行该研究。

sections.title_en: Trace AI findings back to sessions
sections.title_zh: 把 AI 结论追溯到研究过程
sections.en: The product lists transcripts, annotations, video clips, sentiment analysis and AI reports. These are ways to navigate and summarize study material, not independent validation of an interpretation. For each important conclusion, preserve the participant context and supporting moment, and inspect contrary responses. Decide who can access recordings before inviting stakeholders.
sections.zh: 产品列出转录、注释、视频片段、情感分析和 AI 报告。这些工具用于浏览和归纳研究材料，并不独立验证解释。重要结论应保留参与者背景和支持片段，同时查看反例。邀请相关人员前，应明确录屏访问权限。

sections.title_zh: 区分样本库场次与自行招募
sections.en: The pricing page describes project-based purchases with a five-session minimum, annual volume plans, self-recruitment subscriptions and a custom Limitless offering. It displays inconsistent figures: one block says Enterprise as low as $30/session, another says $34/session; self-recruitment shows $699/month paid annually while a FAQ mentions older Premium and Advanced amounts. A single normalized starting price would hide these contradictions, so it remains unset. Request a quote specifying panel versus own participants, session duration, seats and annual commitment.
sections.zh: 定价页介绍至少五场的项目采购、年度批量方案、自行招募订阅及定制 Limitless 方案，但金额存在冲突：一处写 Enterprise 最低每场 30 美元，另一处写每场 34 美元；自行招募显示年付折算每月 699 美元，FAQ 又提到其他 Premium、Advanced 金额。统一起价会掩盖冲突，因此留空。询价时应明确样本库或自有人群、场次时长、席位和年度承诺。

sections.title_en: Start with a pilot and a recruitment decision
sections.title_zh: 先做试点并确定招募方式
sections.en: Prepare a URL or prototype, a neutral task script and screeners before selecting participants. Review a pilot recording for access problems, missing audio and leading questions before scaling. Userlytics is relevant when remote task evidence and organized analysis are needed; a platform does not resolve biased recruitment or replace a specialist moderator for every sensitive topic. This review did not verify self-hosting, source licensing, retention guarantees or regulated-data eligibility.
sections.zh: 先准备网址或原型、中性任务脚本和筛选题，再选择参与者。扩大研究前，应检查试点录制中的访问问题、缺失音频及诱导性提问。需要远程任务证据和整理分析时可以考虑 Userlytics，但平台无法消除招募偏差，也不能在所有敏感主题上替代专业主持人。本文未核实自托管、源码许可、保留保证或受监管数据适用性。
